name: Alert
description: An inline feedback message component that communicates status or important information to the user. Supports four semantic variants: info, success, warning, and danger.

notes: Danger and warning alerts use role='alert' (assertive, interrupts screen readers).
Success and info alerts use role='status' (polite, waits for idle).
When onClose is provided, a dismiss button is rendered with an accessible label.
The icon is aria-hidden — decorative only.
Title is bold and rendered as a strong element.

variant.description: Semantic variant controlling color and icon.

title.description: Bold heading text for the alert.

onClose.description: When provided, a dismiss button is rendered (unless closeable is false).

closeable.description: Whether the close button is visible. Defaults to true when onClose is provided. Set to false to hide the close button even when onClose is provided.

icon.description: Override the default variant icon. Pass null to suppress.

labels.description: Override default labels for internationalisation. AlertLabels: { dismiss: string }.

do: Use 'danger' for errors or destructive consequences.
Use 'warning' for non-critical cautions that require attention.
Use 'success' for confirmations of completed actions.
Always include a title or description — never an empty alert.
dont: Do not use Alert for transient notifications — use Toast instead.
Do not use 'danger' for general information.
Do not place multiple alerts on a page when one summary would suffice.
